name: Arugal Must Die
summary: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver sends champions against Arugal. The rogue archmage holds Shadowfang Keep, and his worgen menace threatens the Forsaken’s hold on Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Thorn in the Dark Lady's Side
sections.body: Shadowfang Keep rises above the woods, where Archmage Arugal commands the worgen. The Forsaken have made the Sepulcher their base, but Silverpine Forest remains dangerous and fiercely contested. Driven mad by guilt and dark sorcery, Arugal unleashed the feral worgen upon Lordaeron. His ravenous beasts roam the forest paths and hinder Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s efforts to secure the region.

sections.title: Striking the Beast at the Neck
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver knows that hunting worgen across the forest will not end the danger. Their source lies inside Shadowfang Keep. You must breach the old stronghold, fight through Arugal’s worgen brood, and confront the mad wizard in his aerie. His severed head is proof of his death, and his defeat can break his hold over the region.

faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver want Arugal dead?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver wants Arugal dead because his worgen overrun Silverpine Forest. Until the mage is slain, the Forsaken cannot make the region a secure stronghold.
Archmage Arugal can be found in Shadowfang Keep, high above southern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What proof is required to complete the mission?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver requires the severed Head of Arugal as proof of the wizard’s death.

faq.q: What threat does Arugal pose to the Horde?
faq.answer: Arugal commands legions of cursed worgen that harass Horde forces and threaten Forsaken control throughout Silverpine Forest. He also wields potent offensive magic.
Dalar Dawnweaver serves Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken. He works from the Sepulcher to strengthen Forsaken control across Lordaeron.

faq.q: What happens after Arugal is defeated?
faq.answer: Arugal’s death breaks his magical grip over Silverpine, letting the Forsaken extend their hold across western Lordaeron without fear of his coordinated worgen packs.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you help secure your southwestern border and protect the routes between the Sepulcher and the Undercity.
As a member of the Horde, you help break an entrenched wizard and open vital roads, showing the Horde’s growing reach in the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a mage, you face a Kirin Tor mage warped by otherworldly summons, a warning of arcane hubris.
